title: Ryu's hardest fight was with himself in Street Fighter
subject: ryu
description:
Should Ryu have accepted the dark power? 👇

How Ryu learned to control the Satsui no Hado and used it to bring down M. Bison. Spoilers for Street Fighter IV and Street Fighter V: A Shadow Falls.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ryu's master came back from the dead to save him.
Gouken had survived Akuma's Raging Demon by emptying his soul, then woke from a long coma.
In Street Fighter IV, he sealed Ryu's dark power with the Power of Nothingness.
In Street Fighter V, a creature called Necalli hunted him to devour that darkness.
On the roof of the Kanzuki Estate, Ryu stopped running from it and took control.
Inside the Shadaloo base, one Hadoken full of nothingness cracked M. Bison's body apart.
At a waterfall with Ken, Ryu tied his headband back on. The road never ends.
